en.text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

zhSimplified.text: 我们原知道，我们这地上的帐棚若拆毁了，必得 神所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。

zhTraditional.text: 我們原知道，我們這地上的帳棚若拆毀了，必得上帝所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。

en.text: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

zhSimplified.text: 我们在这帐棚里叹息，深想得那从天上来的房屋，好像穿上衣服；

zhTraditional.text: 我們在這帳棚裏歎息，深想得那從天上來的房屋，好像穿上衣服；

en.text: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

zhSimplified.text: 倘若穿上，被遇见的时候就不至于赤身了。

zhTraditional.text: 倘若穿上，被遇見的時候就不至於赤身了。

en.text: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

zhSimplified.text: 我们在这帐棚里叹息劳苦，并非愿意脱下这个，乃是愿意穿上那个，好叫这必死的被生命吞灭了。

zhTraditional.text: 我們在這帳棚裏歎息勞苦，並非願意脫下這個，乃是願意穿上那個，好叫這必死的被生命吞滅了。

en.text: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 为此，培植我们的就是 神，他又赐给我们圣灵作凭据。

zhTraditional.text: 為此，培植我們的就是上帝，他又賜給我們聖靈作憑據。

en.text: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我们时常坦然无惧，并且晓得我们住在身内，便与主相离。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我們時常坦然無懼，並且曉得我們住在身內，便與主相離。

en.text: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

zhSimplified.text: 因我们行事为人是凭着信心，不是凭着眼见。

zhTraditional.text: 因我們行事為人是憑着信心，不是憑着眼見。

en.text: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

zhSimplified.text: 我们坦然无惧，是更愿意离开身体与主同住。

zhTraditional.text: 我們坦然無懼，是更願意離開身體與主同住。

en.text: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，无论是住在身内，离开身外，我们立了志向，要得主的喜悦。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，無論是住在身內，離開身外，我們立了志向，要得主的喜悅。

en.text: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我们众人必要在基督台前显露出来，叫各人按着本身所行的，或善或恶受报。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我們眾人必要在基督臺前顯露出來，叫各人按着本身所行的，或善或惡受報。

en.text: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

zhSimplified.text: 我们既知道主是可畏的，所以劝人。但我们在 神面前是显明的，盼望在你们的良心里也是显明的。

zhTraditional.text: 我們既知道主是可畏的，所以勸人。但我們在上帝面前是顯明的，盼望在你們的良心裏也是顯明的。

en.text: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

zhSimplified.text: 我们不是向你们再举荐自己，乃是叫你们因我们有可夸之处，好对那凭外貌不凭内心夸口的人，有言可答。

zhTraditional.text: 我們不是向你們再舉薦自己，乃是叫你們因我們有可誇之處，好對那憑外貌不憑內心誇口的人，有言可答。

en.text: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

zhSimplified.text: 我们若果颠狂，是为 神；若果谨守，是为你们。

zhTraditional.text: 我們若果顛狂，是為上帝；若果謹守，是為你們。

en.text: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

zhSimplified.text: 原来基督的爱激励我们；因我们想，一人既替众人死，众人就都死了；

zhTraditional.text: 原來基督的愛激勵我們；因我們想，一人既替眾人死，眾人就都死了；

en.text: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

zhSimplified.text: 并且他替众人死，是叫那些活着的人不再为自己活，乃为替他们死而复活的主活。

zhTraditional.text: 並且他替眾人死，是叫那些活着的人不再為自己活，乃為替他們死而復活的主活。

en.text: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我们从今以后，不凭着外貌认人了。虽然凭着外貌认过基督，如今却不再这样认他了。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我們從今以後，不憑着外貌認人了。雖然憑着外貌認過基督，如今卻不再這樣認他了。

en.text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

footnotes.text: 5:17 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 若有人在基督里，他就是新造的人，旧事已过，都变成新的了。

zhTraditional.text: 若有人在基督裏，他就是新造的人，舊事已過，都變成新的了。

en.text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

zhSimplified.text: 一切都是出于 神；他借着基督使我们与他和好，又将劝人与他和好的职分赐给我们。

zhTraditional.text: 一切都是出於上帝；他藉着基督使我們與他和好，又將勸人與他和好的職分賜給我們。

en.text: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

zhSimplified.text: 这就是 神在基督里，叫世人与自己和好，不将他们的过犯归到他们身上，并且将这和好的道理托付了我们。

zhTraditional.text: 這就是上帝在基督裏，叫世人與自己和好，不將他們的過犯歸到他們身上，並且將這和好的道理託付了我們。

en.text: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，我们作基督的使者，就好像 神借我们劝你们一般。我们替基督求你们与 神和好。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，我們作基督的使者，就好像上帝藉我們勸你們一般。我們替基督求你們與上帝和好。

en.text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

zhSimplified.text: 神使那无罪的，替我们成为罪，好叫我们在他里面成为 神的义。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝使那無罪的，替我們成為罪，好叫我們在他裏面成為上帝的義。
